title: Filter panel disappears when it is expanded and contracted

issues.title: Filter panel disappears when it is expanded and contracted
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Filter panel is disappear when try to expand and contract it. I have to reload page to make the filter panel shows again

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Try to expand then contract the filter pannel
4. Notice the filter panel is disappear

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/c78df471-cc8e-4a20-8b8a-d102f0cb72be)

View below screencast for more detail

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Filter panel is not disappear when try to expand and contract it.

## 🖥️ Screenscasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/34f8497e-9e77-494d-8b94-65e904e757ac


## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
